description: The 21 December nurse-protest result at the exact Infobae URL displayed a sign-in prompt before article text. A fresh access-check recorded an exact-URL hold. A second potential report at Con La Gente Noticias timed out with no HTTP status or body; neither can be used to verify occurrence, demand detail or crowd size.

description: Late-November and January 2021 continuity queries were captured, but no specific outside-month event was verified as a continuation of any December candidate. Absence of a recorded continuation is not evidence that no continuation occurred. Long-running social-aid actions and the abortion-law vigils still have unresolved endpoints/episode boundaries.

summary: The 14 December march for release of detainees described by organizers as political prisoners is supported by one partially readable El Día report. Its subscriber-only notice followed visible event passages; no further access was attempted. End time, any listed state response or protester violence, and independent crowd corroboration remain unknown.
